rules.name: Value and Contra portfolio overlap
rules.summary: A fund house may offer both Value and Contra funds if the portfolio overlap between the two does not exceed 50%.

rules.name: Sectoral/Thematic portfolio overlap
rules.summary: No more than 50% of a sectoral/thematic scheme portfolio may overlap with other sectoral/thematic schemes and other equity categories, except Large Cap. Computed quarterly as the average of daily overlap values at ISIN level (Annexure A).

rules.name: Sector and theme list
rules.summary: Funds are launched as per the list of sectors/themes published by AMFI, in consultation with SEBI, updated half yearly.

rules.name: Category-wise portfolio overlap disclosure
rules.summary: Fund houses disclose category-wise portfolio overlap (equity vs other equity, debt vs other debt, hybrid vs other hybrid) on the AMC website every month.

rules.name: Residual portion of equity schemes
rules.summary: The residual portion may be invested in equity, money market and other liquid instruments, gold and silver instruments as permitted by SEBI and in InvITs, subject to the ceilings in MF regulations.

rules.name: Residual portion of debt schemes
rules.summary: The residual portion may be invested in InvITs, except in Overnight, Liquid, Ultra Short, Low Duration and Money Market funds, subject to the ceilings in MF regulations.

parameters.note: The circular names the exclusions with pre-2026 category names (Ultra-Short Duration, Low Duration); mapped here to their successors.

rules.name: Residual portion of hybrid schemes
rules.summary: The residual portion may be invested in InvITs (except arbitrage funds), ETCDs, Gold ETFs and Silver ETFs, subject to the ceilings in MF regulations.

rules.name: Reduced duration in adverse situations
rules.summary: The fund manager may reduce portfolio duration by up to one year when anticipating adverse interest rate movements. Going below the 3 year / 4 year floors must be justified in writing, placed before the Trustees and reported in the half yearly Trustee report to SEBI.

rules.name: Sectoral debt fund conditions
rules.summary: Offered only where enough investment grade paper is available for the sector. Sectoral exposure limits under clause 12.9.1 of the Master Circular do not apply.

rules.name: Macaulay duration disclosure
rules.summary: The concept of Macaulay duration is explained in the scheme information document, and the duration is stated at portfolio level.

rules.name: Solution Oriented category discontinued
rules.summary: Existing schemes stop all subscriptions with immediate effect and are merged with a scheme of similar asset allocation and risk profile, with prior SEBI approval.

rules.name: Foreign securities
rules.summary: Foreign securities are not treated as a separate asset class.

rules.name: Scheme name and type description
rules.summary: The scheme name is the same as the scheme category. Words that emphasise only the return aspect are not used. The type of scheme description follows the circular.

rules.name: Compliance timeline for existing schemes
rules.summary: Existing schemes align nomenclature, objective, strategy, benchmark and other parameters within 6 months of the circular. Such changes are not fundamental attribute changes.

rules.name: Life Cycle Fund structure
rules.summary: Tenures of 5 to 30 years in multiples of 5. At most 6 funds per fund house may be open for subscription at any time. A fund with under 1 year to maturity may be merged with the nearest maturity Life Cycle Fund with unitholder consent. Below 5 years to maturity, equity arbitrage exposure of up to 50% is allowed on top of the equity range, keeping total equity and equity related exposure at 65% to 75%. ETCDs are based on gold or silver only.

rules.name: Life Cycle Fund exit load
rules.summary: Exit load of 3% within one year of investment, 2% within two years and 1% within three years.

rules.name: Life Cycle Fund benchmark and name
rules.summary: Follows the benchmark framework for Multi Asset Allocation Funds. The maturity year is part of the scheme name, for example Life Cycle Fund 2055.

rules.name: Residual portion
rules.summary: The residual portion is the part of a scheme's corpus not invested in its main, core asset classes as provided in the scheme characteristics.

rules.name: Standardised FoF framework (multiple underlying funds)
rules.summary: Applies to FoFs with more than one underlying fund. Each FoF is launched under one of the Annexure C sub-categories and one of three options. At least 95% of total assets goes into the underlying funds. Existing FoFs beyond the permitted number are grandfathered and cannot add more in that sub-category.

options.active: FOFs investing in multiple active funds
options.passive: FOFs investing in multiple passive funds
options.active_and_passive: FOFs investing in multiple active and passive funds

overseas_selection_factors: a certain threshold of collective AUM following the overseas indices of such overseas funds
compliance of such indices with portfolio concentration norms for passive indices
parameters.overseas_underlying_requirement: exposure in securities as defined under the Securities Contract (Regulation) Act, 1956 and other applicable regulations/guidelines
parameters.additional_regions: AMFI, in consultation with SEBI, may define additional regions

existing_fofs.above_permitted_number: grandfathered; no further FoFs may be launched in that sub-category
existing_fofs.grandfathering_basis: request and rationale received from the AMC

rules.name: Number of FoFs a fund house may launch
rules.summary: Per sub-category and option (active, passive, active and passive) limits from Annexure IV. A null value means the option is not available.

rules.name: FoF benchmarks
rules.summary: Benchmarks FoFs may use per type, from Annexure II.

options: Tier 1 Benchmark closely related to the Theme/factor
Benchmark close to the duration/credit profile

entries.statement: Policy framework for composition of benchmark of Income Plus Arbitrage FoF: the benchmark represents both debt and arbitrage schemes in line with the weights of the scheme asset allocation, and each weight is at least the minimum of the asset allocation range of that asset class.
debt_indices: CRISIL Short Term Bond Fund Index
constraints: Once a debt or arbitrage index is selected it is not changed ad hoc; a change needs due process including prior intimation/approval of SEBI.
Once the weights of the underlying debt and arbitrage schemes are decided they are not changed without due process including prior intimation/approval of SEBI.
Weights follow the Scheme Information Document / investment pattern of the scheme.
Only the listed indices may be used for the underlying debt and arbitrage components.

entries.statement: As per the policy framework for composition of benchmark of the multi asset allocation fund category.

options: Gold + Silver (or any other allowed commodities)
entries.statement: Weightages of these benchmarks should be at least the minimum of the investment range of that particular underlying fund.

Benchmark of the underlying overseas MF schemes or broad market benchmark or weightages of these benchmarks should be at least the minimum of the investment range/duration/credit profile of that particular overseas underlying fund as per the SID.
